decision.scopeOfAccept: This ACCEPT is of g12-leftover-join.v5 as a CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED design-contract candidate that binds NOTHING. It is not a recording, not a SATISFIED, not a QUALIFIED, and not authority to apply, seal or occupy anything. DR-G12 stays OPEN, DR-114 stays OPEN, required-now stays 28, leftover-design of OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING remains, occupancy v6 (D-221) remains the current G12 occupancy remasurement, doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 (D-285) remains the current DR-114 ROW leftover-join, and leftover-join.v4 remains the current recorded G12 leftover-join until a later decision records this successor.
decision.rationale: This is a leftover remeasurement occasioned by a sibling-lineage successor, so the review targeted the failure modes that move creates. The central one, that the subject still rests on doctor-actor leftover-join.v11 as v4 did, fails on inspection of every live field: registerRowNote, authorityClaim, purpose, leftoverDesignOpenStanding, doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone, OBL-G12-INPUT-CORPUS, OBL-DR114-LEFTOVER-NOT-STOLEN, doctorJoinV6.role, doctorJoinV11.role and doctorJoinV12.role all name v12 as current and v11 as history, and the v12 set the subject quotes is the seven-member set its bytes carry, identical to v11's. The second, that the occupancy claim moved under cover of an unrelated remeasurement, fails on the diff: no occupancy pin, list or value changed. The third, that a carried v4 sentence still speaks as v4, fails on a full-text scan: the one deictic sentence speaks as v5 and v4's own deictic sentence was rewritten as history. The fourth, that the two lineages collide through a bare token, fails: every v3/v4/v6/v11/v12 token is lineage-qualified, and v4's two bare tokens were qualified in v5. Custody is exact: every digest recomputed from live bytes matches, every commit resolves to its 'D-NNN: ' recording, D-288 is the last heading and HEAD, the d257-to-d288 swap follows the D-276 precedent, and predecessorV4 carries D-258. Six observations remain, all carried verbatim from dual-accepted predecessors or sanctioned by the prompt, none false, none within this fold's scope. Zero MUST-FIX, zero SHOULD-FIX: ACCEPT.
